tasks.title: Add provider availability cooldown state
tasks.prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding durable provider availability/cooldown models and a small atomic store. Represent quota pause resume_after, temporary backoff, unauthorized state, and healthy availability without credentials or provider session IDs. Add pure evaluation against an injected timezone-aware now and atomic human-readable JSON persistence with tests for due/not-due cooldowns, invalid timestamps, round-trip, and secret rejection.

tasks.title: Add routed cycle execution
tasks.prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding provider-agnostic routed cycle execution that selects an eligible registered provider using the deterministic router, runs the existing cycle/checkpoint machinery, records provider_id in the returned execution metadata, and preserves sticky resume: a checkpoint with an existing provider/session must resume on that same provider rather than silently switching providers. Only a new/replanned task may select another provider. Add focused offline tests for primary success, quota fallback before session creation, sticky resume, unavailable sticky provider producing an explicit wait/replan outcome, and no eligible provider.

tasks.title: Prove multi-provider failover under CI
tasks.prompt: Finish the Phase 10 routing core with an offline deterministic probe using two fake CodingAgentProvider implementations. Prove preferred-provider selection, quota-before-session fallback to a second provider, no failover after a provider session has been created, sticky crash resume to the original provider, and explicit no-provider outcome. Print compact JSON and run it explicitly in CI. Do not add real credentials or external network calls.
